y-m-68-03.title: Unofanira kuziva kukosha kupi kuti uzive slope ye inverse function?
y-m-68-03.topic: Nzira dzakasiyana dzekusiyanisa: ruzivo rwunodiwa kutara kukosha kwe derivative ye inverse function
y-m-68-03.goal: Rongedza ruzivo rwunodiwa nerusingadiwi pakutsvaga kukosha kwe derivative ye inverse function g'(3), uye usiyanise kuti "kukosha pa poinzi ipi" kunogona kutarwa neruzivo rumwe chete.
y-m-68-03.material:
Function f inogona kusiyaniswa pa real numbers dzose, uye f'(x) > 0 kune x yose. Saka f ine inverse function g, uye g inogonawo kusiyaniswa. Ndiko kuti, g(f(x)) = x kune x yose. Mudzidzi akanyora makosha anozikanwa e f pamakadhi kuti atsvage kukosha kwe g'(3). Makadhi ose ndezvokwadi.
Kadhi ① f(1) = 3
Kadhi ② f'(1) = 5
Kadhi ③ f'(3) = 29
Kadhi ④ f(3) = 33
Fomula haizikanwi, uye ruzivo rwuripo ndirwo rwemhando 4 idzi chete. (Verenga se: f prime of 1, g prime of 3.)

y-m-68-06.title: Derivative ye x^x: mashoko aani akarurama, pakati pevadzidzi vaviri?
y-m-68-06.topic: Nzira dzakasiyana dzekusiyanisa: kutonga mafomula maviri e derivative ye x^x uchishandisa umboo
y-m-68-06.goal: Dzidza nyaya apo data yenhamba papoinzi imwe isingagoni kuparadzanisa mafomula maviri e derivative, gadzira muenzaniso unopikisa unosefa fomula yakashata uchishandisa makosha e function oga, uye utsanangure kuti nei fomula yakashata inoratidzika yakarurama nekuenderana papoinzi imwe.
y-m-68-06.material:
Vadzidzi vaviri vakawana derivative ye f(x) = x^x (x > 0). (Verenga se: x to the power of x.)
Mudzidzi A: "Exponent i x, saka mu (x^n)′ = n·x^(n−1), isa x panzvimbo ye n, uye f′(x) = x·x^(x−1) = x^x."
Mudzidzi B: "Kutora natural logarithm yemativi ese maviri, ln f = x·ln x, uye kudiffirentiate kunopa f′/f = ln x + 1, saka f′(x) = x^x·(ln x + 1)."
Kutarisa kuti ndiani akarurama, average rate of change pa x = 1, (f(1.001) − f(1)) / 0.001, yakawanikwa necalculator uye yakabuda anenge 1.0010.

y-m-68-06.s.s1.r.a: Izvo zvechokwadi, asi fomula ya B zvakare i 1·(ln 1 + 1) = 1 pa x = 1. Kuti utaure kuti rinotsigira fomula imwe chete, imwe fomula yaifanira kusaenderana nedata iri.
y-m-68-06.s.s1.o.b: Rinotsigira B chete. B akafamba kusvika pakushandisa logarithms uye i nzira inongwarira zvikuru, saka inoenderana nedata.
y-m-68-06.s.s1.r.b: Nzira yakaoma haiiti kuti mhedzisiro ive yakarurama. Unofanira kuenzanisa data nemutengo wefomula imwe neimwe zvakananga.

y-m-68-06.s.s1.r.c: Wakaisa x = 1 mufomula imwe neimwe, wakaenzanisa mitengo, uye wakagadzirisa kana data richisiyanisa fomula mbiri.

y-m-68-06.s.s1.r.d: Average rate of change pa interval ye 0.001 i approximation inobuda padyo kwazvo ne slope ye tangent line. 1.0010 ne 1 zvinenge zvakafanana.
y-m-68-06.s.s1.explain: Fomula ya A x^x nefomula ya B x^x(ln x + 1) zvose i 1 pa x = 1 nekuti ln 1 = 0. Kana data pa poinzi imwe rinoenderana nefomula dzese mbiri, data iro harigone kusiyanisa fomula mbiri. Kuti uvasiyanise, unoda data pa poinzi apo mitengo yefomula mbiri yakasiyana.

y-m-68-08.topic: Nzira dzakasiyana dzekudiffirentiate: kutsanangurira muduku nezve derivative ye function ine expression mukati
y-m-68-08.goal: Uchiremekedza kunzwisisa zvisizvo kwemuduku akadzidza Calculus I chete (kuona 3x sebhuroko rimwe nekushandisa fomula sezvayakaita), nyora tsananguro inosanganisira kutarisa kunogona kuitwa nemuduku pachake nechikonzero chekuti mhinduro iyoyo yakaipa.
y-m-68-08.material: Muduku akadzidza kudiffirentiate ma polynomial functions ne derivative ye sin x chete akanyora derivative ye y = sin 3x seizvi: "(sin x)′ = cos x, saka (sin 3x)′ = cos 3x." Muduku akafunga kuti kana ukaona 3x sebhuroko rimwe ine chimiro chakafanana ne sin x. Chinodiwa nemuduku hakusi kungoudzwa mhinduro yakarurama asi nzira yekutarisa pachake. (Verenga se: sine ye 3x, cosine ye 3x.)

y-m-68-04.title: Curve inopfuura nepa origin kaviri: tangent line imwe chete here?
y-m-68-04.topic: Nzira dzakasiyana dzekusiyanisa: tangent lines kune curve yakapiwa neparameter (poinzi imwe chete, tangent lines dzakasiyana)
y-m-68-04.goal: Dzidza kuti ma coordinates epoinzi oga anogona kusatara tangent line imwe chete ye curve yakapiwa neparameter, gadzira iwe pachako makosha eparameter anogutsa mamiriro, uye utaure kuti chii chimwe chaunofanira kuziva.
y-m-68-04.material: Curve C inopiwa kune real number t se x = t² − 9, y = (t³ − 9t)/3. Sezvo t ichichinja, poinzi (x, y) inofamba nepa curve. Semuenzaniso, kana t = 0, poinzi ndi (−9, 0). t = 3 ne t = −3 zvose zvinopfuura nepa origin (0, 0). Apo t ichifamba kubva ku−3 kusvika ku3, poinzi inosiya origin, inotenderera kamwe padivi rekuruboshwe apo x ≤ 0, uye inodzokera kuorigin. Saka curve inosangana nayo pachayo pa origin. Slope ye tangent line inotarwa nenzira iyo poinzi iri kufamba pa t (asi unogona kutaura slope chete papoinzi apo x inochinja pamwe chete ne t).

y-m-68-04.s.s1.o.a: Origin ipoinzi apo x = 0, saka t = 0, uye ipapo rate yeshanduko ye x ndi0, saka slope ye tangent line haigoni kutarwa.
y-m-68-04.s.s1.r.a: T dzine x = 0 dzinobva ku t² = 9, saka t = 3 kana t = −3. t = 0 ipoinzi (−9, 0), kwete origin.
y-m-68-04.s.s1.o.b: Origin inopfuurwa kaviri, pa t = 3 nepa t = −3, uye slope inosiyana nguva imwe neimwe, saka ma coordinates epoinzi oga haagoni kupa slope imwe chete.
y-m-68-04.s.s1.r.b: Wakasiyanisa kuti pa t ipi curve inopfuura napoinzi imwe chete, uye wakatarisa zvakaparadzana tangent lines papoinzi inopfuurwa kaviri.
y-m-68-04.s.s1.o.c: Origin inopfuurwa pa t = 3, saka slope yakatarwa sekukosha kumwe chete. t = −3 inongoverenga poinzi imwe chete kamwe zvakare.
y-m-68-04.s.s1.r.c: Nzira iyo curve inopfuura nayo pa origin pa t = −3 yakasiyana neyepa t = 3. Kunyange papoinzi imwe chete, kana nzira yekupfuura yakasiyana, tangent line inogona kusiyana.
y-m-68-04.s.s1.o.d: Origin ipoinzi apo y = 0 uye curve inyambuka x-axis, saka slope ye tangent line ndi0.
y-m-68-04.s.s1.r.d: Curve kusangana ne x-axis hakureve kuti tangent line yakafanana ne x-axis. Unofanira kutarisa zvakaparadzana nzira yekufamba papoinzi iyoyo.
y-m-68-04.s.s1.explain: Pa t = 3, rate yeshanduko ye x ndi6 uye rate yeshanduko ye y ndi6, saka slope ndi1, uye pa t = −3 rate yeshanduko ye x ndi −6 uye rate yeshanduko ye y ndi6, saka slope ndi −1.
